page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.16xlarge is a general-purpose server belonging to the ecs.g7 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance features 64 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, resulting in 64 vCPUs. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage is not included, meaning storage must be network-attached, while network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core capabilities. The instance achieves a strong rating in multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng and Geekbench, as well as a strong Passmark CPU score. It demonstrates high efficiency in parallelized workloads, showing strong performance in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, and image processing. Memory performance is also robust, with a strong Passmark memory score. However, single-core benchmarks, such as stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core, fall into the average tier.

From a resource-density perspective, the dedicated core allocation offers predictable performance without hyperthreading overhead, representing a high-value hardware profile for multi-threaded applications. However, the lack of local NVMe storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs for I/O-heavy tasks. The instance is highly suited for workloads such as static web serving, database operations, software compilation, and moderate LLM inference tasks using smaller models, where it exhibits strong prompt processing and text generation speeds.
